title: M31 echelon: wire m31_batch_dot_fn into gemm_axpy_into_view (869ce43b row 33 follow-up)
description:
Phase 6 follow-up filed under epic `026fc832`. Predecessor: `869ce43b` (blocked echelon R0 closed 14/18 PASS; row 33 GF(2^31-1)/n=1024/deficient FAIL @ 2.37× routed here).

## Background

The `869ce43b` blocked echelon implementation closes 14 of 18 A8 echelon cells but FAILs row 33 (GF(2^31-1)/n=1024/deficient @ 2.37×). Root cause documented at `dev/bench_results/2026-05-26-869ce43b-blocked-echelon.md` § 5: the Mersenne31 batch-dot kernel `m31_batch_dot_fn` exists but is NOT dispatched from `gemm_axpy_into_view`. The current `SimdVecOps::try_simd_dot_vec` guard at `crates/gf2-core/src/gfp/simd_ops.rs:237-241` covers only `3 <= P <= 251`. Stage 3a of the blocked back-sub falls back to scalar `dot_product_slices` for Mersenne31, which at n=1024 dominates the wall time.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `gemm_axpy_into_view` dispatches `m31_batch_dot_fn` for `Fp<MERSENNE_31>` matrices passing the existing `GEMM_AXPY_FAST_PATH_THRESHOLD = 16³ = 4096` size gate.
- [hard] Re-bench A8 row 33 (GF(2^31-1)/n=1024/deficient echelon) via the `869ce43b` measurement harness. Closes PASS (≤ 1.5× vs fflas) or carries explicit user-approved [aspirational] amendment.
- [hard] No regression on currently-PASSing Mersenne31 cells (delta ≤ 5%, paired tight-session bench).
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness preserved across Mersenne31 echelon proptest sweep (use the existing `prop_blocked_rref_mersenne31` test on `crates/gf2-core/src/field/ple.rs`).
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside kernel crates.

## Out of scope

- Other Mersenne31 ops (PLE, invert, solve — already PASS or covered by sibling wave-7b issues).
- Non-Mersenne31 dispatch paths.
